input.quote: TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement and that rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party.
input.rationale: The only most-favoured-nation language in the Agreement runs in our favour: § 6 (p0047) obliges TrueLink to keep Hosting Services rates at or below those charged to any other party (plus a one-year price freeze). Nothing in the COMPENSATION section (§ 5, p0044–p0047) or the Client covenants (§ 8, p0050–p0058) requires Client to extend TrueLink terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers, and searches for MFN-style wording ("most favored", "no less favorable", "best price", "any other party") surface no Client-side obligation. This meets the preferred position — no MFN burdening Customer — so per the detection guidance we do not redline the Vendor-granted MFN.
